name: Ballybunny-ke no 3 Kyoudai
original_name: バルバニー家の３きょうだい
source:
Welcome back to the mansion. It's been a long time.

…the children of the Ballybunny family are too much for the other servants to handle. Maybe you can unravel their woes.

...even if it doesn't end happily.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6859]NovelGame[/url]]
